show.description: A promise of love turns into a storm of betrayal, violence, and revenge. When Priya, pregnant with her husband Ruhan’s child, is mistaken for a mistress, she’s dragged into a brutal web of public humiliation and personal vendettas. Will truth and justice prevail, or will hatred destroy everything? Watch Now !
